_meta.note: Complete reference locale. Every key used by the engine lives here.

analytics_summary_chats: {n} customer chats in the last 7 days.
analytics_summary_missed: {n} chats needed a human and are still waiting — check the inbox.
booking_ask_name: Great — what's your name for the booking?
booking_ask_phone: And a phone number where we can reach you?
booking_ask_when: When would you like to come in? You can say a date like 2026-10-15, or 'tomorrow'.
booking_cancelled: Done — your booking for {when} is cancelled.
booking_confirmed: You're booked! {service} on {when}. We'll see you then. Reply 'cancel' any time to cancel.
booking_no_slots: No free slots on {date}. Here are the nearest open ones: {alts}
booking_not_found: I couldn't find a booking for that phone number.
bot_disclosure: Hi, I'm {bot_name}, the AI assistant for {business}. I can help with questions, our catalog, bookings and order status — and I'll bring in a human whenever you need one.
catalog_empty: I couldn't find anything matching that. Want me to ask {owner_word} about it?
catalog_intro: Here's what I found in our catalog:
catalog_out_of_stock: That one's currently out of stock.
demo_badge: Demo AI — connect an LLM key for full intelligence
escalation_approval_needed: That needs {owner_word}'s approval, so I've sent them a summary with everything you've told me. They'll reply here shortly.
escalation_brief_approval: Customer asked for {topic}, which needs owner approval.
escalation_brief_human: Customer asked to speak to a human.
escalation_brief_low_confidence: AI couldn't confidently answer after {n} tries.
escalation_fallback: I'm not confident I understood that correctly, so rather than guess, I've asked {owner_word} to step in. They'll continue right here.
escalation_human_requested: Of course — I've notified {owner_word}. They'll pick this up right here in this chat, so you don't need to repeat anything.
fallback: I want to make sure I get this right — could you say that a little differently? Or type 'human' and I'll bring in {owner_word}.
greeting: Hello{comma_name}! How can I help you today?
greeting_returning: Welcome back{comma_name}! What can I do for you?
needs_decision_approval: Approve or decline the customer's {topic} request, then reply in this chat.
needs_decision_default: Reply to the customer in this chat.
payment_not_found: I couldn't find that order. Double-check the order ID, or I can bring in {owner_word}.
setup_step5_done: WhatsApp hook saved. Setup complete — you're live!
payment_claim_confirmed: Payment received ✓ Order #{order_id} confirmed — {money}. Thank you!
payment_claim_wrong_amount: Thanks! We received {got}, but order #{order_id} is {expected}. I've flagged this to {owner_word} — they'll sort it out with you here shortly.
payment_claim_unmatched: Thanks! We got your payment ({money}, ref {ref}) but couldn't match it to an order. I've asked {owner_word} to check — they'll confirm with you here shortly.
payment_claim_duplicate: Looks like payment {ref} was already counted toward order #{order_id}. I've flagged it to {owner_word} to double-check — no double charge, I promise.
payment_order_pending: Order #{order_id}: still waiting on {money}. The moment it lands, I'll confirm it here instantly.
needs_decision_payment: Resolve this payment issue, then confirm with the customer in this chat: {detail}
ledger_summary: {c} orders confirmed, {p} waiting on payment, {x} need your attention.
escalation_brief_novel: Novel request the AI couldn't answer from shop data: “{verbatim}”
escalation_novel: That's a new one for me — I've sent your exact question to {owner_word}. They'll reply here shortly, and I'll remember the answer for next time.
customization_none: Every custom piece is made to order — tell me what you'd like, and {owner_word} will personally take it up with you here.
delivery_ask_pincode: Where should we deliver? Share your 6-digit pincode and I'll check the charges and timing.
delivery_found: Good news — we deliver to {pincode} ({zone}): delivery {fee}, {days} days{cod}.
delivery_no_zone: We don't deliver to {pincode} yet. I've asked {owner_word} to check — they'll confirm here shortly.
delivery_no_data: Let me check delivery with {owner_word} — they'll confirm here shortly.
voice_note_no_stt: I got your voice note, but I can't listen to it yet — could you type your message? (Voice transcription unlocks with an STT key.)
